notes: Gross sales, orders, units and AOV: Norce ORDERED data (order date, Stockholm day, every status except 6, all Babyshop + Lekmer applications), same definition as the Daily performance tab. Gross sales = MERCHANDISE ex VAT, excluding freight, because the forecast's Gross Sales line excludes shipping; freight is ~2% on top. Gross of returns, like the plan line. Complete days only (norce-sync closes yesterday at 03:00).

Net sales, GP1, GP2, ad cost, GP3 and COS%: Funnel export, the KV Overview's de-duplicated numbers. Norce has no cost (CostUnit is empty) and no returns, so these cannot be built on the ordered basis. Funnel days can still grow for ~2 days.

Targets: Finance's November forecast (budget_2026.json) spread per day by November 2025's daily shape, lined up by event (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, payday, weekday) with the KV Overview's own daily_targets model. We use that event-aligned shape rather than last month's, because October has no Black Friday peak; the October-shaped curve is a toggle for comparison.

The KV Overview's version of the same model pulls last year's shape 70% toward a flat month (tuned on Feb-Jul, months without Black Friday). In November that puts ~10% of the month into 1-3 Nov instead of last year's 5% and flattens the Black Friday peak, so it reads far behind early in the month. This tab uses the full shape; the 'KV Overview model' toggle shows the other one. Monthly totals are identical.

Market targets: the forecast is global only, so each market's target is the global target × that market's share of the same metric in Nov 2025 (event-aligned; Norce mix for gross sales, Funnel mix for the rest). Norce market = the ordering application (SE/NO/FI/DK incl. Lekmer; EU, UK, NA, Asia, ROW apps = ROW). Market GP3 = market GP2 − market ad cost. The mix has moved a lot since then (NO and DK roughly doubled in Oct 2026 YoY; international revenue moved from 'ROW EUR' to named countries), so per-market targets are a rough guide: NO/DK read ahead, ROW reads behind.

1 Nov: All Saints' Day fell on 1 Nov 2025 but on 31 Oct 2026, so 1 Nov 2026 has no last-year twin and the model gives it an average-day target × the Sunday factor (~1.9 M). It reads behind on that day for that reason.
Ad cost target = Finance's whole marketing line (5.54 M), which also holds non-ad channels; actual ad cost is de-duplicated Funnel ad spend.
Last year = same weekday 364 days earlier, so Black Friday 27 Nov lines up with 28 Nov 2025 and Cyber Monday 30 Nov with 1 Dec 2025.
Landing = MTD actual + remaining daily target × the last 7 complete days' actual/target ratio.

New vs returning: Norce orders on order date; new = the customer's first-ever order in that shop. Norce history starts 11 Jun 2025, so last year's 'new' is overstated (anyone who last bought before June 2025 counts as new). Revenue there is merchandise ex shipping, so new + returning = Norce gross sales MTD.
